description: This file contains utility functions for replacing nodes with higher-order operators in Torch FX graphs, including helper functions for graph transformation, node replacement, and recursive graph module processing.

methods.name: _replace_with_hop_helper
methods.description: Replaces a node with a higher-order operator node, updating metadata and handling different output types.

methods.name: _sequential_split_and_maybe_inline_subgraphs_helper
methods.description: Splits a graph module into subgraphs, optionally inlining or replacing with higher-order nodes, and fixes output signatures.

methods.name: _replace_with_hop_pass_helper
methods.description: Recursively splits and processes a graph module into submodules, applying transformations and reassembling.
